segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַדֶּלֶת שֶׁבַּמּוּקְצֶה, וַחֲדָקִים שֶׁבַּפִּרְצָה, וּמַחְצָלוֹת — אֵין נוֹעֲלִין בָּהֶן אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן גְּבוֹהִים מִן הָאָרֶץ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «the door to a rear court,» i.e., a door that opens from a house to the courtyard situated behind it, which is typically not a proper door but merely a wooden board without hinges that closes off the doorway; «and» likewise «bundles of thorns» that seal «a breach; and» reed «mats, one» may «not close» an opening «with them» on Shabbat. This would be considered building or completing a building, «unless they» remain «above the ground» even when they are open.

moves.summary: rule on closing with makeshift doors

positions.claim: one may not close with these unless they are raised above the ground
